title: Offline Preference Optimization via Maximum Marginal Likelihood Estimation
authors_zh: Saeed Najafi, Alona Fyshe（阿尔伯塔大学）
paper_type_zh: 离线偏好优化目标研究
best_for_zh: 适合比较 DPO 类目标、希望稳定使用既有偏好数据集且不训练显式奖励模型的读者。
one_line: MMPO converts each offline preference pair into a normalized maximum-marginal-likelihood objective that implicitly up-weights the chosen response.
MMPO 将每个离线偏好回答对转化为归一化的最大边缘似然目标，并隐式提高优选回答的权重。
why: It changes the optimization consumer of an unchanged preference dataset and empirically studies the trade-off between alignment gain and retained general capability.
inclusion_reason: It redefines how every chosen-rejected record contributes to offline preference optimization through an MML objective and data-dependent response weighting.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Offline preference alignment normally receives a fixed set of chosen-rejected pairs, but the objective used to consume those pairs can be highly sensitive to its regularization scale. DPO simplifies RLHF yet retains a contrastive objective derived from reward maximization, while related objectives can either drift or lose general capability as the hyperparameter changes. This makes a static preference dataset behave differently under small changes in optimization settings.

MMPO asks whether preferred responses can be learned from the same pairs through a simpler likelihood principle rather than an explicit reward formulation or an entropy bonus. It targets the objective that turns records into gradients. The paper is therefore about the training use of existing pairwise labels, not about collecting more labels or generating better candidates.

离线偏好对齐通常接收固定的优劣回答对集合，但用于消费这些回答对的目标可能对正则化尺度非常敏感。DPO 简化了 RLHF，却仍保留了从奖励最大化推导出的对比目标；相关目标会随着超参数变化而漂移或损失通用能力。这使同一个静态偏好数据集在优化设置轻微改变时表现不同。

MMPO 询问能否从同一批回答对中，通过更简单的似然原则学习优选回答，而不使用显式奖励表述或熵奖励。它针对的是把记录变成梯度的目标。因此，论文讨论的是已有成对标签的训练使用方式，而不是收集更多标签或生成更好的候选回答。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
MMPO treats a chosen and rejected answer as two samples used to approximate the marginal likelihood of generating the desired answer from an input. Its numerically stable log-sum-exp objective yields gradients that raise the chosen answer's score more than the rejected answer's score, with the amount determined by their current score difference. Preference behavior emerges from that weighting rather than from a separately learned reward model.

The implementation normalizes chosen and rejected scores within a batch and retains a DPO-style auxiliary term. The authors argue that normalization and the subtraction inside log-sum-exp stop scores from growing without bound, making beta less brittle. Thus the method does not filter records; it changes the optimization geometry through which every pair is consumed.

MMPO 把优选和劣选回答视为两个样本，用于近似在给定输入下生成理想回答的边缘似然。其数值稳定的对数和指数目标产生的梯度，会比劣选回答更高地提升优选回答分数，提升量由两者当前分数差决定。偏好行为由这种加权产生，而不是由单独学习的奖励模型产生。

实现会在批内归一化优选和劣选分数，并保留一个 DPO 风格的辅助项。作者认为，归一化和对数和指数内部的相减可以阻止分数无限增长，使 beta 不那么脆弱。因此，该方法并不筛选记录；它改变的是每个回答对被消费时所经过的优化几何。

title: Method
方法
html:
The paper starts with an MML formulation in which an output is produced through a partially observed process, then approximates the marginalization with the two responses in a preference pair. In the practical loss, model and reference log probabilities form chosen and rejected scores, those scores are normalized, and log-sum-exp plus a DPO-style logistic auxiliary loss are minimized. The derivation shows why the resulting weighted gradient favors the chosen response without an explicit reward or entropy-maximization term.

Experiments combine 12,359 Orca DPO Pairs training examples and 61,135 UltraFeedback-Binarized pairs. The authors train SmolLM2-135M, SmolLM2-360M, Llama-3.2-1B, and Llama-3-8B variants, tune on validation reward accuracy, then study five epochs under beta values 0.01, 0.05, and 0.5. DPO and SimPO are the direct baselines; the 8B setting uses LoRA on attention projections and an 8-bit Adam optimizer.

论文从一种最大边缘似然表述开始，其中输出通过部分可观测过程产生，再用偏好回答对中的两份回答近似边缘化。在实际损失中，模型和参考模型的对数概率形成优选与劣选分数，这些分数被归一化，并最小化对数和指数与 DPO 风格逻辑辅助损失。推导说明为何产生的加权梯度会偏向优选回答，而不需要显式奖励或熵最大化项。

实验合并了 12,359 个 Orca DPO Pairs 训练示例和 61,135 个 UltraFeedback-Binarized 回答对。作者训练 SmolLM2-135M、SmolLM2-360M、Llama-3.2-1B 和 Llama-3-8B 变体，在验证集奖励准确率上调优，再研究 beta 为 0.01、0.05 和 0.5 时的五个训练轮次。直接基线是 DPO 和 SimPO；8B 设置在注意力投影上使用 LoRA 与 8 位 Adam 优化器。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across smaller models, the paper reports a more favorable alignment-capability trade-off for MMPO than DPO. At each method's peak general-capability point, MMPO's AlpacaEval 2 win rates are 61.86% for SmolLM 135M, 66.47% for 360M, and 64.03% for Llama 3.2 1B, versus 6.21%, 57.06%, and 46.57% for DPO. The 8B result is mixed: DPO reaches a higher peak win rate, 64.53% versus 63.37%, and a higher accompanying LM Harness accuracy.

The paper reports that MMPO varies little across the three tested beta values, while DPO and SimPO are more sensitive. On SmolLM2-135M, its mean win rate rises from 47.7% at epoch one to 67.3% at epoch five. Ablations show that removing in-batch normalization or the DPO-style auxiliary can raise preference win rate slightly but harms peak LM Harness accuracy; adding the tested token-level entropy term degrades both reported metrics.

在较小模型上，论文报告 MMPO 比 DPO 具有更有利的对齐—能力折中。在各方法通用能力达到峰值的点，MMPO 在 AlpacaEval 2 上的胜率分别为 SmolLM 135M 的 61.86%、360M 的 66.47% 和 Llama 3.2 1B 的 64.03%，而 DPO 分别为 6.21%、57.06% 和 46.57%。8B 结果较为混合：DPO 达到更高的峰值胜率 64.53%，MMPO 为 63.37%，并且伴随更高的 LM Harness 准确率。

论文报告 MMPO 在三个测试 beta 值之间变化很小，而 DPO 和 SimPO 更敏感。在 SmolLM2-135M 上，其平均胜率从第一轮的 47.7% 上升至第五轮的 67.3%。消融显示，去除批内归一化或 DPO 风格辅助项可略微提高偏好胜率，却损害峰值 LM Harness 准确率；加入所测试的词元级熵项会降低两项报告指标。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Most direct preference objectives start from a contrastive surrogate of reward maximization. MMPO instead starts from the marginal likelihood of a desired output and uses the pair as a two-sample approximation. The key novelty is not the use of a different dataset but a derivation showing that this likelihood objective implicitly carries out preference optimization through data-dependent chosen-versus-rejected gradient weights.

The method combines this reformulation with batch normalization and a retained DPO-style auxiliary term, then tests which pieces trade preference win rate against general capability. This makes the contribution more than a new algebraic loss: it offers a hypothesis about why an offline preference objective can be less sensitive to beta while consuming identical labeled records.

大多数直接偏好目标从奖励最大化的对比替代目标出发。MMPO 则从理想输出的边缘似然出发，并把回答对用作双样本近似。关键新意不在于使用不同数据集，而在于推导表明该似然目标通过依赖数据的优选—劣选梯度权重，隐式执行偏好优化。

该方法把这一重构与批内归一化及保留的 DPO 风格辅助项结合，再检验哪些部分会在偏好胜率和通用能力之间形成折中。这使贡献不只是一个新的代数损失：它提出了一个假设，解释为何离线偏好目标在消费相同带标签记录时可以对 beta 更不敏感。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The authors could not directly test models above one billion parameters without memory-saving techniques; their 8B study is parameter-efficient rather than full-parameter training. The method is evaluated only for static offline pairs, so online sampling, changing rewards, and comparisons with PPO or GRPO remain open. Its principal alignment metric averages two LLM judges, and the favorable results at small scales do not transfer unambiguously to the constrained 8B setting.
作者无法在不使用节省内存技术的情况下直接测试超过十亿参数的模型；其 8B 研究是参数高效训练，而非全参数训练。该方法只在静态离线回答对上评估，因此在线采样、变化的奖励以及与 PPO 或 GRPO 的比较仍待探索。其主要对齐指标平均了两个大模型评判器，且小规模上的有利结果并未毫无歧义地迁移到受限的 8B 设置。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: MMPO is useful for teams that already own a pairwise preference corpus and want to compare objective-level choices before spending effort on new reward modeling or data generation. Its ablations make it a helpful reference for separating alignment gain from retention of general language ability. It is less directly useful for pipelines whose bottleneck is acquiring diverse or reliable labels, because it assumes the input pair ordering already exists and changes only how those pairs are optimized.
对于已经拥有成对偏好语料、并希望在投入新的奖励建模或数据生成之前比较目标层面选择的团队，MMPO 很有用。其消融使它成为区分对齐收益与通用语言能力保留的有用参考。对于瓶颈在获取多样或可靠标签的流程，它不那么直接有用，因为它假定输入回答对的排序已存在，只改变这些回答对如何被优化。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the objective derivation before the leaderboard tables: the essential claim is that marginal likelihood induces a preference-weighted gradient, not merely that another loss wins a benchmark. Then read Figure 1 with Tables 1 and 2, which distinguish the peak capability point from the peak preference point. Finally inspect the ablations and the 8B caveat; they show that the apparent stability relies on a particular combination of normalization and auxiliary loss and should not be interpreted as dominance over DPO at every scale.
在阅读排行榜表格之前先阅读目标推导：关键主张是边缘似然诱导出偏好加权梯度，而不只是另一个损失赢得基准。接着把图 1 与表 1、表 2 一起阅读，它们区分通用能力峰值点和偏好峰值点。最后检查消融和 8B 的注意事项；它们表明表面上的稳定性依赖归一化与辅助损失的特定组合，不能被解释为在每个规模上都胜过 DPO。
